campo_electricidad: Rune-only energy field for 60 s, ML 6; the hardest-hitting field tile.
campo_fuego: First castable field, fire for 60 s, ML 4; burns the caster too.
campo_veneno: Rune-only poison field for 60 s, ML 4; weakest field, cast from a stone.
crear_runa_aliento_vital: Charges a heal rune, ML 1 from Maera; a zero-mana heal saved for later.
crear_runa_blanca: Blank rune from mana alone, ML 1; the reagent every charged rune consumes.
crear_runa_campo_electricidad: Energy-field rune recipe, ML 6 from Vero; the only route to the strongest field.
crear_runa_campo_fuego: Charges a fire-field rune, ML 4 from Maera; fire walls laid later, zero mana.
crear_runa_campo_veneno: Poison-field rune recipe, ML 4 from Maera; the only route to that field.
crear_runa_cepo_hielo: Charges a slow rune, ML 4 from Vero; an escape carried as a stone.
crear_runa_corazon_brasa: Charges the 3x3 fire-burst rune, ML 6 from Vero; area damage, no cast time.
crear_runa_estallido: Charges a self-nova rune, ML 5 from Maera; fires around the user, no aiming.
crear_runa_golpe_arcano: Charges an arcane-dart rune, ML 1 from Maera; cheapest recipe, 25 mana per stone.
crear_runa_miasma: Charges the big poison-nova rune, ML 9 from Vero; priciest lesson, 900 gold.
crear_runa_rosario_sombras: Charges the shadow-chain rune, ML 10 from Vero; the highest-ML recipe, 195 mana.
keth_dor: First self-area nova, ML 5; anchored on the caster, you stand in the group.
keth_gel: Ice nova, ML 6; the only area spell that also slows, buys an exit.
keth_nox_maug: Big poison nova, radius 2, ML 9; the only area hit that also poisons.
lig_gel: Pure single-target slow, 60% for 8 s, ML 4; makes fleeing a mechanic.
lig_tor: Hard slow, 90% for 5 s, ML 7; a root in all but name.
oc_keth: Radius-3 taunt, ML 2 free; the only spell that rewrites a creature's target.
sil_za: Blink 3 tiles forward, ML 3; a blocked jump still costs the mana.
sil_za_maug: Long blink of 6 tiles, ML 9 from Ubbo; needs the short blink first.
umbra_un: Flat +6 armor for 30 s, ML 6; doubles early mitigation, little for iron.
va_gel_un: Mana regen over 30 s, ML 5; only non-potion mana recovery, small net gain.
va_lum: Self light for 60 s, ML 1 free; a torch that takes no slot.
va_nox: Cure, ML 3 from Vero; strips every damaging condition at once, castable on allies.
va_sil: Haste for 15 s, ML 2 free; the escape button on its own clock.
va_sil_maug: Big haste, +75% for 25 s, ML 7; replaces the small one, never stacks.
va_tempo: HP regen drip for 30 s, ML 5; heals more in total, useless mid-hit.
va_tempo_un: Attack +30% for 30 s, ML 6 from Vero; also buffs the defensive block.
va_tor_un: Mana shield, ML 10 from Ubbo; turns mana into a second HP bar.
va_un: Cheap single-target heal, ML 0 free; the baseline the other heals are tuned against.
va_un_maug: Big emergency heal, ML 8 from Ubbo; the only heal with a cast time.
za_dor: Fire bolt, ML 4; the mid-game single-target standard, free from Maera for a fang.
za_dor_maug: Target-centred 3x3 fire burst, ML 6 free; 800 ms cast, rolls per victim.
za_dor_sil: Fire cone opening with distance, ML 8; priciest attack, 1 s cast punishes moving.
za_gel: Ice twin of the fire bolt, ML 3; slightly cheaper, slightly weaker, different resistance.
za_gel_sil: Ice cone wave, ML 8 from Ubbo; cheaper than fire, pays damage for slow.
za_keth: Cheapest attack spell, ML 1 from Maera; the no-element dart that trains magic level.
za_keth_sil: Five-tile beam along your facing, ML 7; aimed by body, stopped by walls.
za_nox: Pure damage-over-time, ML 4 from Vero; no upfront hit, beats fire on long fights.
za_tor: Range 6 physical stone, ML 1 free; worst damage per mana, longest reach.
za_tor_keth: Largest hit in the game, ML 11 from Ubbo; 2 s cast, easily interrupted.
za_umbra: Shadow drain, ML 5 from Vero; heals the caster half the rolled damage.
za_umbra_maug: Shadow chain of 4 hops, ML 10 from Ubbo; each link loses a quarter.
